mapper.select: select t.id, t.tag_name, tag_count.article_count, preview.article_id, preview.article_title from blog_tag t inner join ( select bat.tag_id, count(*) as article_count from blog_article_tag bat inner join blog_article a on bat.article_id = a.id where bat.deleted_at = 0 and a.deleted_at = 0 and a.status = 1 group by bat.tag_id ) tag_count on t.id = tag_count.tag_id left join ( select ranked.tag_id, ranked.article_id, ranked.article_title, ranked.row_num from ( select bat.tag_id, a.id as article_id, a.article_title, row_number() over ( partition by bat.tag_id order by a.create_time desc, a.id desc ) as row_num from blog_article_tag bat inner join blog_article a on bat.article_id = a.id where bat.deleted_at = 0 and a.deleted_at = 0 and a.status = 1 ) ranked where ranked.row_num <= 3 ) preview on t.id = preview.tag_id where t.deleted_at = 0 order by article_count desc, t.id, preview.row_num
